release.name: v0.2 Online Invoice Payments
release.goal: A customer can open an invoice link and pay it by card; the shop owner sees it marked Paid.

issues.title: Confirm CI runs tests on every PR
issues.body: Brownfield safety net: make sure the existing test suite runs on pull requests and is green on the default branch.
acceptance: A PR triggers the test workflow
The workflow is green on the default branch

issues.title: Add invoice payment tables and migration
issues.body: Persist payment attempts and invoice status transitions.
acceptance: Migration applies and rolls back cleanly on an empty and a populated database
Invoice status can be unpaid, paid, or failed
Existing invoice queries still pass their tests

issues.title: POST /invoices/:id/pay endpoint
issues.body: Accepts a payment token, charges via the payment provider, updates invoice status.
acceptance: Successful charge marks the invoice paid and records the attempt
Declined card returns a clear error and leaves the invoice unpaid
Paying an already-paid invoice is rejected without charging
Endpoint requires a valid invoice link token

issues.title: Fix 'recieve' typo on the pricing page
Customer-facing pay page
issues.body: Public page reached from the invoice link, shows amount due and a card form.
acceptance: Page shows invoice number and amount due
Error state shown on decline, with a way to retry
Already-paid invoices show a receipt instead of a form
